record.quote: Skip to main content Newsroom Capital Group Announces Appointment of New Chief Information Officer Guillermo Veiga joins in November from Standard Chartered Bank in Singapore LOS ANGELES, August 26, 2026 – Capital Group, the world’s largest global active investment manager, announced the appointment of Guillermo Veiga as Chief Information Officer.
